messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: high queue depth on us-west2-spot-pool — queue_length=21450, q95_latency=2.4s, failed_autoscale_events=6 in last 10m. Autoscaler error: "quota_exceeded: per-project GPU quota". Pagerduty: P12345. Dashboard: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/ops/gpu-pool-usw2 (incidents view)
Maya R.: ack — I'm oncall and looking. Any recent deploys to serving runtime?
Samir Patel: no deploys from infra in last 30m. I see a spike in spot evictions across nodes: eviction_rate_usw2 = 0.32 (baseline 0.03).
David K.: confirming customer impact: several orgs reporting high latencies and timeouts. Alerting channel-sales queue. Top affected orgs: AcmeCorp, BetaAI, Finly.
Maya R.: copy. Oncall runbook step 1: check autoscaler logs and fallback policy. Pulling logs now.
Maya R.: (logs) autoscaler error excerpt:
```
2026-09-03T18:20:32Z ERROR autoscaler: failed to create instance - error=quota_exceeded: GPUs quota 0->8
2026-09-03T18:21:05Z WARN nodepool: spot eviction burst, terminating 12 nodes
2026-09-03T18:21:49Z ERROR routing: fallback policy "spot->on-demand" failed: no capacity in fallback pool
```
Samir Patel: looks like fallback pool is depleted — reserved-on-demand pool already at max (committed capacity). We can't spin new on-demand in same region because of soft-account limit.
Lexi (SRE): Paging infra team for quota bump / cloud support. I've opened ticket CS-9823 and requested emergency quota increase.
Maya R.: mitigation plan (short): 1) throttle non-critical tiers, 2) enable region-failover to us-east1 for best-effort customers, 3) reduce batching window to drop q length, 4) spin up emergency dedicated pool in us-east1 if quota permits. Implementing 1 and 2 now.
Maya R.: slash command to update rate-limiter:
```
/rate-limit update --scope=hosted --tier=best_effort --rps=50
```
ops-bot: Rate limiter update queued — new policy will apply in ~30s.
Samir Patel: Initiating routing change to shift best-effort traffic to us-east1: `redwood route update --pool=us-east1-best-effort --matcher=tier:best_effort`
ops-bot: Route updates deployed to edge proxies (v1.18). Starting drain of in-region queues for matched traffic.
David K.: Customer comms: drafting short-status for account teams. Severity: degraded for non-dedicated, critical customers on dedicated unaffected. ETA to initial mitigation effects: 6-12 minutes.
Maya R.: autoscaler still failing to create instances in us-west2 due to GPU quota. While we wait on CS, let's enable emergency fallback to CPU-only inference for some smaller models to preserve request throughput. Enabling model-quality fallback: `runtime-config set --model_fallback=cpu-small --filter=tier:best_effort`
Lexi (SRE): cpu fallback enabled. Caveat: increased latency per token but keeps tail latency bounded.
Samir Patel: starting manual provisioning in us-east1: requesting 8 GPUs in dedicated pool. If quota cleared we'll promote to production.
Maya R.: handoff: Samir, I'm going to step back after 18:40Z, can you take lead? Current tasks: monitor queue, confirm us-east pool spin-up, coordinate with cloud CS.
Samir Patel: taking over. @Maya R. thanks. I'll keep this thread as incident timeline.
incident-bot: PD P12345 acknowledged by Maya R. (oncall). Severity: Sev2.
Samir Patel: quick status at 18:32Z — rate limits applied, ~40% of best-effort requests are now routed to us-east1, queue length in us-west2 dropping from 21.4k -> 12.1k. q95 latency trending down to 1.5s.
Lexi (SRE): cloud support responded: emergency quota increase requested is approved but provisioning will take ~10-15min for GPUs to be available.
David K.: observed error spike in API logs: 502s from the frontend due to long task timeouts. We increased task timeout to 20s as temporary measure.
Maya R.: adding mitigation note: temporarily lower batch size from 64->16 for streaming-heavy models to reduce memory pressure. Command: `runtime-config set --batch_size=16 --model=gpt-small`
Samir Patel: us-east1 dedicated pool request succeeded, 8 GPUs up and registering to serving runtime. Starting traffic drain to include them.
ops-bot: New dedicated pool "emerg-us-east1-8" registered, capacity=8gpus, status=healthy.
Samir Patel: routing update to include emerg pool for best-effort: `redwood route add --pool=emerg-us-east1-8 --matcher=tier:best_effort --weight=1.0`
incident-bot: NOTE: Dataplane throttling triggered for some customers flagged as "trial". Telemetry shows 12% of total requests experienced >5s delay during peak.
Lexi (SRE): confirmed: queue draining, us-west2 qlen down to 6.2k at 18:47Z. q95 latency 0.9s.
David K.: customer impact summary for post-incident: ~8 customer orgs saw degraded performance (timeouts/slow), estimated revenue exposure low; notification recommended for affected accounts.
Samir Patel: root cause hypothesis: spot eviction cascade + depleted fallback pool + autoscaler hitting per-project GPU quota. Missing safety check: autoscaler didn't respect a cross-region failover threshold earlier.
Maya R.: creating follow-up ticket ENGOPS-3456: add cross-region fallback guard, autoscaler should consider fallback capacity before evicting prefixes. Assigning to infra and serving.
Lexi (SRE): post-incident ops: revert temporary rate-limits and batch size after 45m of stability. Schedule postmortem meeting.
Maya R.: Closing timeline: primary mitigations in place by 18:50Z — queue decreasing, most customers routed to fallback pools. Leaving incident open for postmortem and follow-ups.
Samir Patel: marking this thread with reactions :white_check_mark: and will update once postmortem draft is ready.
ops-bot: Incident P12345 updated: status=stabilized, owner=Samir Patel, next_steps=[ENGOPS-3456, CS-9823].
